description: axnic default Renovate preset. Consume it with { "extends": ["local>axnic/.github:default"] }.

Minor and patch updates of versions >= 1.0 are grouped per manager; every minor of a 0.x version (breaking by semver convention) and every major gets its own pull request; patches of 0.x versions are grouped.
Commit subjects follow the organisation convention: build(deps): Sentence-case subject.
Security settings (release age, vulnerability alerts) live in the security preset.

packageRules.description: Force the commit type and scope: presets of config:recommended set 'fix' or 'chore' for some dependency kinds, which commitlint's scope-enum and the organisation convention do not accept.

Never pin nor update the organisation's own reusable workflows and actions (axnic/.github, axnic/rtunk): the generated callers follow @main on purpose and Terraform rewrites them, so a pin would be reverted and would freeze the caller on an old version.
Go indirect requirements are disabled by default in Renovate; Dependabot updated them, so keep them (they matter for security fixes).
Minor and patch updates of versions >= 1.0: one pull request per manager.

packageRules.groupName: github actions minor and patch updates
mise tools minor and patch updates

packageRules.description: Patches of 0.x versions are grouped (minors of 0.x versions stay separate: no group matches them).
The Go language version (go directive) changes the CI toolchain (mise reads it): keep it out of the library group so a Go bump is reviewed on its own.
Node: only even majors (LTS); odd releases are short-lived and never worth a pull request.
